guidelines.title: quiet vs standard background
guidelines.rule: Visible background for dense control arrays / isolated buttons; quiet (no fill) only when a clear stack/table/grid makes the field parseable. Too many quiet controls in a small space are hard to read.
pass_when: Standard (visible background) is used for dense arrays or isolated buttons; quiet is used only where a clear stack/table/grid makes the field parseable.
fail_when: Quiet (no fill) in a dense small space, or isolated buttons with no visible field background.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Hit-target px floors; quiet as a brand default.

guidelines.title: asterisk is icon not label text
guidelines.rule: Required marker uses a spaced icon. If you use an asterisk, include hint text that explains what it means. Never use an asterisk to mark optional.
pass_when: Required is a spaced icon (not asterisk characters inside the label string); hint text explains the marker; optional is not marked with an asterisk.
fail_when: Asterisk is typed as label text; no explanation of the marker; or asterisk marks optional.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A winner vs NN/g mark-optional (`forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`) or Fluent all-required-one-instruction. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`. Overlap with extra 73: `fluent.required-asterisk-or-one-instruction`.

guidelines.title: error icon overrides validation icon
guidelines.rule: When both error and validation icons would apply, show error only.
pass_when: Error state shows the error icon only; the valid/format icon is not shown at the same time.
fail_when: Error and valid icons shown together.
guidelines.do_not_claim: M3 swap supporting text for error as this row.

guidelines.title: readonly vs disabled
guidelines.rule: Disabled = field exists but is unavailable. If the value must still be shown and copied, use read-only, not disabled.
pass_when: Unavailable fields are disabled. Values that must remain visible and copyable are read-only.
fail_when: A value that must be copied is in a disabled field.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Fluent disabled-label-stays-perceivable as a merge; picker read-only (see `spectrum.picker-readonly-only-if-selection`). Overlap with extra 73: `fluent.disabled-field-label-stays-perceivable`.

guidelines.title: mixed values en dash
guidelines.rule: When the field represents multiple non-identical values, show an en dash (–), not a blank or a single value.
pass_when: Mixed non-identical values display an en dash (–).
fail_when: Mixed values shown as blank or as one of the values.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A hyphen/minus as equivalent; bulk-edit architecture.

guidelines.title: min width 1 5x field height
guidelines.rule: Standard and quiet text fields: minimum width 1.5× field height.
pass_when: Standard and quiet text-field width is at least 1.5× the field height.
fail_when: Standard or quiet text field narrower than 1.5× height.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Picker minimum (see `spectrum.picker-min-width-2x-height`); WCAG/hit-target numbers.

guidelines.title: tab into field selects text
guidelines.rule: Tab into a text field selects existing text.
pass_when: Keyboard focus into a text field with existing text selects that text.
fail_when: Tab-in places a caret without selecting existing text.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Click-to-edit caret placement.

guidelines.title: validation icon when format valid
guidelines.rule: For email/card/password-rules fields, show the valid icon as soon as the typed value matches the format. Dual-cite NN/g success-for-complex; this is the format-as-you-type icon, not a spam-success on required-filled.
pass_when: Format-constrained fields show the valid icon when the typed value matches, not merely because a required field has any characters.
fail_when: Valid icon on any filled required, or no valid icon when the format already matches.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Generic error identifies-and-fixes; success spam on every required. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.success_complex_fields`.

guidelines.title: toast vs dialog
guidelines.rule: Toast only for confirmations, simple notifications, and low-priority alerts that must not fully interrupt. Dialog when the situation needs attention or a response. Do not use a dialog for a simple upload-complete.
pass_when: Low-priority confirmations/notifications use toast; situations that need attention or a response use dialog.
fail_when: Dialog for a simple upload-complete; or toast for a situation that needs attention/response.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A winner vs NN/g modal 7 (`nng.modal-and-nonmodal-dialogs`); Ant Message vs dialog (separate rows).

guidelines.title: toast placement geometry
guidelines.rule: Default bottom center. Desktop: 16 px from the bottom of the viewport. Mobile: 16 px above the bottom toolbar; never wider than the viewport (8 px left/right margins). If unnoticed or disruptive, may move to bottom end, top end, or top center.
pass_when: Default is bottom center with those desktop/mobile offsets and margins; alternate corners only if unnoticed or disruptive.
fail_when: Default placement other than bottom center with no unnoticed/disruptive reason, or toast wider than the viewport / overlapping the cited margins.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Ant Message top-center as a house winner.

guidelines.title: dont place mobile toasts over navigation
guidelines.rule: Don't place mobile toasts over navigation.
pass_when: Mobile toast sits 16 px above the bottom toolbar / not over navigation.
fail_when: Mobile toast covers navigation.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Desktop bottom-center geometry as this row.

guidelines.title: toast at most one action
guidelines.rule: At most one action — a static white, secondary, outline button; concise; only when the action is directly related to the toast text.
pass_when: Zero or one related concise action, styled as that secondary outline control.
fail_when: Two or more toast actions, or an unrelated action on the toast.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Polar modal max two bottom actions as this toast row.

guidelines.title: toast no redundant dismiss
guidelines.rule: No redundant Dismiss — every toast already has a close control.
pass_when: No extra Dismiss action besides the toast close control.
fail_when: A Dismiss button in addition to the close control.
guidelines.do_not_claim: That the close control may be omitted.

guidelines.title: one toast at a time
guidelines.rule: One toast at a time — consecutive/simultaneous toasts follow a priority queue; do not stack multiple visible toasts.
pass_when: Only one toast is visible; others wait in a priority queue.
fail_when: Multiple toasts stacked/visible at once.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Bundle copy (see `spectrum.bundle-instead-of-spam-toasts`).

guidelines.title: bundle instead of spam toasts
guidelines.rule: Bundle instead of spam — e.g. four uploads → one toast, not four. Be mindful of frequency even though toasts are weaker than dialogs.
pass_when: Related events (e.g. four uploads) are one bundled toast.
fail_when: One toast per related event in a burst.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Queueing (previous row) as the bundle rule.

guidelines.title: users can turn off alert types
guidelines.rule: Users can turn off all alert types — products should allow this for people who need to focus.
pass_when: Alert types can be turned off.
fail_when: No way to turn off alert types.
guidelines.do_not_claim: `actions.confirm.bypass_educational` as a merge.

guidelines.title: toast auto dismiss min 5s
guidelines.rule: Auto-dismiss ≥ 5 seconds so the message can be read. If an actionable toast auto-dismisses, the action must remain available elsewhere. Pause the timer on focus or hover (including keyboard focus on toast buttons).
pass_when: Auto-dismiss is at least 5 seconds; timer pauses on focus/hover; an actionable toast's action remains available elsewhere after dismiss.
fail_when: Auto-dismiss under 5 seconds; timer ignores focus/hover; or the only path to the action vanishes with the toast.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Ant Message default 3s as a house winner; snackbar-only undo (`nng.support-undo-discoverable`).

guidelines.title: toast writing formulas
guidelines.rule: Confirmation (neutral/positive): optional noun + past-participle -ed + optional prepositional phrase; UI element names in bold. Informational: complete sentence (subject + verb + optional extra). Error: short phrase + in-line action when possible. Keep under 2 lines in English (localization grows).
pass_when: Copy matches the confirmation / informational / error formula; under 2 lines in English; UI names bold on confirmation.
fail_when: Wrong formula for the toast type, or more than 2 lines in English.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Tone/generic-language (next row) as this formula.

guidelines.title: toast sentence case generic tone
guidelines.rule: Sentence case, no period on a single sentence; instructive/neutral tone (not playful, celebratory, or promotional/upsell); generic language (no filenames/usernames/folders unless necessary).
pass_when: Sentence case; single sentence has no period; tone is instructive/neutral; names/files omitted unless necessary.
fail_when: Title Case; period on a single sentence; playful/celebratory/upsell; unnecessary filenames/usernames/folders.
guidelines.do_not_claim: General UI sentence-case already filed (Actions/Forms) as a delete of this toast row.

guidelines.title: picker ghost text placeholder
guidelines.rule: Picker placeholder ("ghost text") is allowed — prompts selection and disappears once a value is chosen. CONFLICT with Spectrum text-field "don't use placeholder" and NN/g placeholders. Dual-cite; picker-only. Do not pick a winner.
pass_when: A picker may show ghost-text that disappears after a value is chosen, and text fields still have a visible label (in-field hint extra, never only label).
fail_when: A text field uses disappearing placeholder as the only label; or picker ghost-text is treated as a pass for text fields.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A winner that bans picker ghost-text or legalizes placeholder-as-only-label on text fields. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.field_labels.visible_label` / `forms.field_labels.placeholder_hint_conflict`. Extra 73 skipped Polar/Fluent placeholder-as-hint.

guidelines.title: picker mobile tray when overwhelming
guidelines.rule: Mobile menu container — popover or tray. Use a tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover.
pass_when: Mobile picker uses popover, or tray when the option count would overwhelm a popover.
fail_when: A large option set is forced into a popover that the count would overwhelm, with no tray.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house option-count cutoff.

guidelines.title: picker readonly only if selection
guidelines.rule: Read-only only if a selection exists — a picker with no selection has no read-only option.
pass_when: Read-only picker has a selection. Empty picker is not read-only.
fail_when: Read-only picker with no selection.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Text-field read-only vs disabled as this row.

guidelines.title: picker min width 2x height
guidelines.rule: Minimum width 2× field-button height — quiet pickers have no minimum; width follows text.
pass_when: Non-quiet picker width is at least 2× field-button height. Quiet picker width follows text (no minimum).
fail_when: Non-quiet picker narrower than 2× height, or a quiet-picker minimum invented in-house.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Text-field 1.5× minimum as this row.

guidelines.title: picker no max menu height
guidelines.rule: No maximum menu height — grow to show as many options as the available space allows. Field value truncates; menu (and label) wrap.
pass_when: Menu grows with available space (no artificial max); field value may truncate; menu and label wrap.
fail_when: A capped menu that hides available-space options, or menu that truncates like the field.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Item wrapping discouraged (next row) as a max-height rule.

guidelines.title: picker concise items full value
guidelines.rule: Concise menu items; width shows the chosen value in full — wrapping items discouraged; if wrapping is frequent, revise copy or change pattern. Field button should be wide enough that selected items are not ellipsized.
pass_when: Menu items are concise; the field button is wide enough that the selected value is not ellipsized; frequent wrapping is treated as a copy/pattern problem.
fail_when: Selected value ellipsized in the field button, or frequently wrapping items left as-is.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Ant dropdown "option text fully displayed" as a merge that drops picker field-button width.
